newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Black & Decker lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Black & Decker lowered.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Tuesday it lowered its intermediate-term rating on Black & Decker Corp to neutral from accumulate and its long-term rating to accumulate from buy.
-- Merrill analyst Jonathan Goldfarb said the downgrade was partly due to the stock's move toward its price target.
-- Goldfarb also said in a research note that the company's recent presentation to investors "was not especially confidence-inspiring."
-- Goldfarb said he lowered his 1997 earnings estimate to $2.35 per share from $2.40 per share and his 1998 estimate to $2.70 per share from $2.80 per share.
-- "We have difficulty with management's projection of 15 percent average annual earnings growth, and even regard our estimate of 11 percent as somewhat tenuous," he said.
-- Black & Decker shares were off 1/8 at 36-1/8.
